sharpe_recipe: Always use the *_pnl files. sr = pnl[market].dropna().mean() / pnl[market].dropna().std() * sqrt(252). carry_ois_par_pnl: full swap repricing, DV01-neutral 5Y+10Y cross-section, daily rebalance. mean_reversion_pnl: NS classic MR full repricing, daily rebalancing, factor-neutral NS residuals, λ frozen on data through 2015-12-31, 100 bp/yr vol target. momentum_a_daily_pnl: full swap repricing, per-tenor vol-scaled positions, 252d formation.
